description: KNaAs₆(PbO₃)₈ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.74-3.08 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.82 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.84 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.84 Å. In the third Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.46 Å. In the fourth Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.74 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.74 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pb, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Pb, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one K, two Pb, and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pb, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, two Pb, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Pb and one As atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Pb and one As atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Pb and one As atom.
